title: eBay to cut about 1,100 jobs as it streamlines operations and shifts focus to growth areas
llm_summary: eBay plans to lay off roughly 1,100 employees—about 5 % of its workforce—as it trims underperforming units and consolidates its global operations. The cuts are part of a broader effort to sharpen focus on high‑growth segments such as its marketplace and advertising businesses, while reducing costs
